## About
R&C Auto Service has moved from Pleasanton to Livermore. Our shop is on First Street, right next door to Big O Tires, and we still look after drivers from Pleasanton, Dublin, San Ramon and the rest of the Tri Valley.
We work out of a fully equipped facility and handle everything from basic maintenance to complex projects and engine work. Our goal is to do the job right the first time and make your visit a good one.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 191 Google reviews, and many of them mention honest pricing and friendly service.

## Services
- Tune-ups and oil changes: Routine care to keep your car running smoothly.
- Factory scheduled maintenance: Keep up with the service schedule your car's maker recommends.
- Brake system repairs: Inspection and repair of your brake system.
- Check engine light: Bring your car in when the check engine light comes on and we'll find out why.
- Computer diagnostics: We use diagnostics to pin down what's going on with your car.
- AC service and repair: Get your air conditioning working again.
- Transmission service and replacement: From routine transmission service to a full replacement.
- Suspension and steering: Work on your suspension and steering system.
- Pre-purchase inspections: Have a used car looked over before you buy it.

## FAQ
Q: Where is the shop now?
A: We moved from Pleasanton to Livermore. You'll find us at 4037 First Street, Suite #1, Livermore, next door to Big O Tires.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I text the shop?
A: Yes. You can text us at (925) 400-8099.
